reason: Verified in source and by driving the page. render-b.js:242 field(kids, extra) hard-codes aria-label 'The plan for ' + F.project.name, and render-b.js:230 foot() hard-codes 'Updated ' + F.updatedLabel. states['owner-empty'] (render-b.js:608) renders sibling = F.siblings[1] = 'Aisling & Tom' in both the bar and the h1, then wraps it in that field() and that foot(). Driving master.html?v=approach&state=owner-empty returns region aria-label 'The plan for Mara & Finn' while the bar reads 'Aisling & Tom' and h1 reads 'AISLING & TOM', and the footer reads 'KEPT BY ORLA | UPDATED 15 JULY 2026 | SIGNAL TIMELINE' on a project that has never held a single item. Both halves are real: a screen-reader user is told the wrong couple's plan, and a false fact is printed as fact. This is the fixture-leak class in lessons.md:108 recurring, and no gate covers it — interaction-check.mjs touches owner-empty only for phone padding (l.203), dead controls (l.539) and the refusal path (l.660); nothing asserts identity consistency or the absence of a bogus stamp. Not taste, not a constraint breach, not gate-restatement. The refusal sub-claim is also real but minor: the field is labelled 'The day', the heading asks 'When is the day?' and the button says 'Set the day', yet the refusal says 'Pick the date of the day first.' - 'pick' implies a picker on what is a text input, and 'the date of the day' is clumsy.
sharpenedFix: Take the fix but correct two details. (1) field(kids, extra, projectName) with aria-label 'The plan for ' + (projectName || F.project.name) is right and safe - all 9 existing call sites pass two args, so the default holds. Pass sibling.name from states['owner-empty']. (2) foot(stamp) with the Updated span emitted only when a stamp is given, and no stamp on owner-empty: .b-foot is flex/space-between (b.css:296-304), so two spans lay out correctly with no CSS change. Leave the separate hardcoded footer at render-b.js:739 alone - that state is genuinely Mara & Finn. (3) Do NOT ship 'Type the date first.' The finding's own argument is that date and day are not two words for two things on this screen; the label, heading and button all say 'day'. Use 'Type the day first.' and update the existing gate assertion at interaction-check.mjs:667, which currently matches /Pick the date/ and will fail on any new string. (4) Add the proposed owner-empty gate assertion: the region aria-label, the h1 and the bar name the same project, and footer textContent contains no 'Updated'.
